title: Jellyfish UAP debunked

tellings.quote: it ended up being debunked it it wasn't any it was not a a u UAP

related.note: The same jellyfish UAP video Corbell released, but this speaker claims it was debunked and was not a UAP, which conflicts with the story's account of it as a UFO.

plain: An unidentified object that became known as the "jellyfish" UAP (UAP is the US government's term for unidentified flying or anomalous objects) turned out to be nothing unexplained, according to an unnamed speaker in a clip played on the show. The speaker says "it ended up being debunked" and "was not a UAP."
